question: Who made the first chocolate bar?A. NestleB. The Harshey CompanyC. Joseph Fry & Sons.D. Pearson's (RRB NTPC Tier I (16/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: B
A
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Joseph Fry & Sons

Explanation:
The first chocolate bar was made in 1847 by Joseph Fry & Sons. They mixed cocoa butter, cocoa powder, and sugar to form a solid bar. Before this, chocolate was only consumed as a drink. Joseph Fry & Sons was a major British chocolate company that revolutionized the chocolate industry. Later, in 1875, Daniel Peter created the milk chocolate bar. Hershey Company and Nestle came later. Pearson's was also a chocolate manufacturer, but the first chocolate bar was made by Joseph Fry & Sons.

☛ How was chocolate consumed before the chocolate bar? → As a drink

options_hi: B
A
C
D
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है जोसेफ फ्राई एंड संस

Explanation:
पहला चॉकलेट बार साल 1847 में जोसेफ फ्राई एंड संस ने बनाया था। इसमें कोकोआ बटर, कोकोआ पाउडर और चीनी को मिलाकर एक ठोस बार बनाया गया था। इससे पहले चॉकलेट केवल पेय के रूप में पी जाती थी। जोसेफ फ्राई एंड संस ब्रिटेन की एक प्रमुख चॉकलेट कंपनी थी, जिसने चॉकलेट उद्योग में क्रांति ला दी। बाद में 1875 में डैनियल पीटर ने दूध चॉकलेट बार बनाया। हर्शी कंपनी और नेस्ले बाद में आईं। पियर्सन भी एक चॉकलेट निर्माता था, लेकिन पहला चॉकलेट बार जोसेफ फ्राई एंड संस ने बनाया था।

question_hi: क्वॉलिटी लिमिटेड, डेयरी उत्पादों का प्रोसेसर का यंत्र भारत के किस राज्य में  हैं? (RRB NTPC Tier I (16/04/2016) Shift 1)

Explanation:

question: International Women’s day celebrated on ______ March every year.A. 6thB. 7thC. 8thD. 9th (RRB NTPC Tier I (19/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: B
C
A
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is C (8th March)

Explanation:
International Women's Day is celebrated every year on 8th March. It is a day dedicated to celebrating the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women. It also raises awareness about gender equality and women's rights. The United Nations first celebrated International Women's Day in 1975 and officially recognized it in 1977. The day is observed globally with various events, rallies, and conferences. Each year a specific theme is set, focusing on women's issues and promoting gender parity.

☛ Who sets the theme for International Women's Day? → United Nations

question: Pakistani film industry is known as _______A. PollywoodB. LollywoodC. KollywoodD. Mollywood (RRB NTPC Tier I (19/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: C
D
A
B
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lollywood

Explanation:
The Pakistani film industry is known as Lollywood. This name is derived from Lahore, the city where most film production takes place in Pakistan. The term 'Lollywood' is a combination of 'Lahore' and 'Hollywood'. The industry primarily produces films in Urdu and Punjabi languages. Among the other options, Pollywood refers to the Punjabi film industry, Kollywood refers to the Tamil film industry, and Mollywood refers to the Malayalam film industry.

question: World Wetland day is celebrated every year on _______February.A. 2ndB. 3rdC. 4thD. 5th (RRB NTPC Tier I (19/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: B
A
C
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2nd February

Explanation:
World Wetlands Day is celebrated annually on 2nd February. This day marks the anniversary of the signing of the Ramsar Convention in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran. The convention aims to promote the conservation and wise use of wetlands. Wetlands are vital ecosystems that support biodiversity, water purification, flood control, and climate regulation. India has over 75 Ramsar sites. Each year, a specific theme is chosen to highlight the importance of wetlands. The day serves as a reminder of the urgent need to protect these natural habitats from degradation and loss.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was the Ramsar Convention signed? → 2nd February 1971
☛ Where is the Ramsar Convention headquarters? → Gland, Switzerland
☛ Which Indian state has the most Ramsar sites? → Tamil Nadu
☛ What was India's first Ramsar site? → Keoladeo National Park (1981)
☛ What was the theme of World Wetlands Day 2024? → Wetlands and Human Wellbeing

question: In which year did Ole Romer measure the speed of light for the first time in history?A. 1776B. 1676C. 1876D. 1867 (RRB NTPC Tier I (27/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: A
D
B
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1676

Explanation:
The speed of light was first measured by Danish astronomer Ole Romer in 1676. He observed the eclipses of Jupiter's moon Io and deduced that light travels at a finite speed. According to his calculation, light takes about 22 minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth (modern value is 8 minutes 20 seconds). This measurement was a landmark in astronomy. Romer estimated the speed of light to be approximately 220,000 km/s, which is lower than the modern value of about 300,000 km/s, but it was the first successful attempt.

question: Which of the following statues in an icon of freedom designed by a French Sculptor?A. Statue of UnityB. Statue of LibertyC. Statue of LawD. Statue of Zeus (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 2)

question: In which of the following states was the first passenger train started in India?A. MaharashtraB. Tamil NaduC. Uttar PradeshD. West Bengal  (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: A
C
B
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A (Maharashtra)

Explanation:
India's first passenger train ran on April 16, 1853 between Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Thane, covering a distance of about 34 km. It was operated by the Great Indian Peninsula Railway (GIPR). The train had three engines named: Sahib, Sindh, and Sultan. This event marked the beginning of Indian Railways. Subsequently, in 1854, the Eastern Railway started its first train from Howrah to Hooghly. Thus, Maharashtra holds the distinction of hosting the first passenger train in India.

question: Thomas Clifford Allbutt is associated with the invention of:A. X ray MachineB. Clinical ThermometerC. StethoscopeD. Microscope (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: D
B
C
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Clinical Thermometer

Explanation:
Thomas Clifford Allbutt was a renowned English physician who invented the first practical Clinical Thermometer in 1866. Earlier thermometers were very long and took about 20 minutes to measure body temperature. Allbutt's thermometer was smaller and could record temperature accurately in just 5 minutes. This invention was a major advancement in medical science. The X-ray machine was invented by Wilhelm Röntgen, the stethoscope by René Laennec, and the microscope by Antonie van Leeuwenhoek. Thus, Allbutt is associated with the clinical thermometer.

question: Antonio Meucci is associated with the invention of:A. TelephoneB. automobileC. LEDD. Industrial Robot (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: D
B
C
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Telephone

Explanation:
Antonio Meucci was an Italian inventor who made significant contributions to the development of the telephone. He demonstrated a device for voice communication in 1854, which he called the 'teletrofono'. Although Alexander Graham Bell received the first commercial telephone patent, the US Congress recognized Meucci's contribution in 2002, crediting him with the invention of the telephone. This technological innovation revolutionized the field of communication, laying the foundation for modern telephony. Meucci's work involved creating a voice-communication link by using electricity to transmit sound through wires.
